name: chladni-portal-dilogarithm-synthesis
title: Nodal Chamber Equipartition, Critical-Point Index Dichotomy, and Weighted Prime-Simplex Dilogarithm Integrals for Riemann's Xi-Function
core_theorems: Theorem 2.1: Local Nodal Branch Dichotomy, Bounded Loop/Arch Exclusion, and Harmonic Curvature Conservation (1/2)*d_d^2[R(d,tau_*(d))^2]_{d=0} == -F(tau_*)*F''(tau_*) == c_1(tau_*)

Theorem 2.4: Critical-Point Index Connection (Craven-Csordas-Smith 1987, Ki-Kim 2000), Self-Dual Davenport-Heilbronn Case-I Certification (c_1^{DH}(tau_{false,m}) < 0 for m = 1..5), and Speiser Difficulty Caveat

Theorem 3.1: Unconditional 50%-50% Green-Dirichlet-Neumann Chamber Equipartition int_{tau_k(d_0)}^{tau_{k+1}(d_0)} R*d_d R dt == int_{tau_k(d_0)}^{tau_{k+1}(d_0)} I*d_d I dt == iint_{Omega_k(d_0)} |F'(t - i*d)|^2 dd dt = (1/2)*W_{Omega_k}(d_0) > 0

Theorem 3.2: Wronskian-Slope Reciprocity tau_k'(d) == (R*d_t R)/W(d,tau_k(d)), Branch-Amplitude Evolution (d/dd)(1/2 R^2) == W(d,tau_k(d))*(1 + tau_k'(d)^2), and Fold-Tip Wronskian Vanishing W(d_tip, t_tip) = 0
Theorem 4.2: Closed-Form Euler Dilogarithm Li_2(2*theta) Laws for Factorized Simplex Weights (1-u)^p(1-v)^p (p in {0, 1, 2, 3}), giving eta_fac^{(2)}(1/6) = 0.6768906167

Theorem 4.3: Closed-Form Euler Dilogarithm Laws for True Additive Semiprime Wronskian Weights (1-u-v)^p (p in {1, 2}), proving M_fac^{(2)} - M_add^{(2)} = (1/8)*(1-2*tau)^2*(3-4*tau) > 0 and eta_add^{(2)}(1/6) = 0.1506038202 < 1/2
Theorem 4.4: Dirichlet Hyperbola Reflection Duality omega_p(t) + omega_q(t) == ln m_dual(pq) and Fourth-Order Product Pinching (omega_p*omega_q)^2 <= (1/16)*(ln m_dual)^4
